title: Billing and Coding: MolDX: Category B IDE Studies

codes.1: This billing instruction pertains to the Galleri Category B IDE test when performed and billed by GRAIL, LLC (North Carolina). Study information can be found here: Approved IDE Studies | CMS and G220255-NCT05673018 | CMS . Claims must contain the following information: Category B IDE number Clinical Trial number CPT 81479 The Z-Code descriptor specific to the Investigational Category B IDE Galleri Test The appropriate HCPCS Modifier The appropriate ICD Diagnosis code A beneficiary may receive up to three Investigational Category B IDE Galleri tests per lifetime.
